final_answer:
The overall pass rate across all 1,000 generated executive reports was **73.5%** when scored by the AI instrument.

This figure represents the average performance of the five prompt strategies (S0 through S4) combined. The study generated a total of 1,000 reports: 200 baseline reports (S0) and 800 strategy reports (200 each for S1–S4). While the AI scoring yielded an average of 73.5%, human-analyst review of a random subset revealed significant discrepancies, with 28.3% of dual-scored reports having their pass/fail verdict changed by the human reviewer.
